title: tc-pixel-loader
description: A pixel-grid working indicator: dots lit in a pattern, a shimmering label and the time since the work started; a check or a cross when it ends. Superseded by tc-thinking-loader with mark="pixels".

label.description: One fixed label instead of `phases` – it stays when the work ends, and the status says how it ended

mark.description: The mark: "rays" (the default) or "pixels", a 5 × 5 grid lit in `pattern`

phases.description: Labels to walk through, one after another

phase.description: The phase shown. The timer moves it on unless a tc-phase-change listener calls preventDefault()

manual.description: The phase is set from outside (e.g. from stream events): no timer

startedAt.description: When the work started, in epoch ms – the done label and the time count from here. Defaults to when the loader connected (or work restarted)

started.description: The same as `startedAt`, kept from Pixel Loader

now.description: The current time, in epoch ms – given, the loader keeps no clock of its own and counts up to it

loop.description: Start over after the last phase instead of holding it – at most twice, then it holds the last phase (WCAG 2.2.2)

state.description: How the work stands: "working" animates and counts; "done" turns the mark into a check; "error" into a cross

done.description: Finished – the same as state="done", kept for existing pages

labels.description: Rename the words for how it ended, over the defaults

pattern.description: How the pixels move: a diagonal "wave", a lit dot that "drive"s a snake path, a seeded "dots" twinkle, or an "orbit" round the edge

hideTime.description: Hides the time since the work started (shown with mark="pixels")

size.description: "md" is the default pill; "sm" is smaller, e.g. inside a chat bubble

variant.description: "pill" = bordered capsule, "plain" = just the mark and the label, e.g. inside a chat bubble
